pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Numbers" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Numbers" to activate' && sleep 5 && osascript -e 'tell application "Numbers" to make new document with properties {document template:template "Personal Budget"}'
instruction: Where is the source data of the two charts? Help me find that data table, and copy the source data table to an empty Pages document.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to count rows of table 1 of front document' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "11" && osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to count columns of table 1 of front document' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "4" && osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to get value of cell "B2" of table 1 of front document' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "200" && osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to get value of cell "C3" of table 1 of front document' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "32" && osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to get value of cell "D5" of table 1 of front document' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "50" && osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to get value of cell "C11" of table 1 of front document' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "1202.75" && echo "True" || echo "False"
